boundaries.authoritative_side: Governed research policy and evidence validation.
boundaries.denied_class: Private access, authenticated mutation, credential use, command execution, or financial action.
boundaries.fail_closed_result: Reject the request and discard untrusted evidence.
boundaries.permitted_class: Modeled public, unauthenticated, read-only research evidence.
boundaries.stage_12b_requirement: Prove public-read capability cannot cross into private or mutating access.

boundaries.authoritative_side: Hermes governed command and approval pipeline.
boundaries.consumer: collaboration workspace and Hermes event consumers
boundaries.denied_class: Unsigned commands, direct execution, policy mutation, credentials, or financial instructions.
boundaries.fail_closed_result: Reject the event and preserve the current authoritative state.
boundaries.permitted_class: Sanitized signed events, messages, approvals, and workflow references.
boundaries.stage_12b_requirement: Prove event transport cannot grant command or execution authority.

boundaries.authoritative_side: Governed fleet routing and worker admission.
boundaries.denied_class: Self-placement, self-dispatch, shell execution, credential access, or automatic failover authority.
boundaries.fail_closed_result: Exclude or quarantine the node from placement.
boundaries.permitted_class: Node identity, capabilities, trust, certification, health, and capacity evidence.
boundaries.stage_12b_requirement: Prove registration alone cannot make a node eligible for placement.

boundaries.authoritative_side: Sigil backend and Hermes governed runtime.
boundaries.denied_class: Backend mutation, connection, dispatch, installation, activation, credential resolution, or broker submission.
boundaries.fail_closed_result: Restore the disconnected paper-only default projection.
boundaries.permitted_class: Read-only and paper-only lifecycle, status, gate, evidence, and integration projections.
boundaries.stage_12b_requirement: Prove desktop projections cannot become authoritative runtime commands.

boundaries.authoritative_side: Governed dispatcher and Sigil financial controls.
boundaries.denied_class: Worker dispatch, broker submission, portfolio mutation, capital authority, or live trading authorization.
boundaries.fail_closed_result: Return no eligible route and deny dispatch or financial execution.
boundaries.permitted_class: Deterministic primary, fallback, exclusion, and placement recommendations.
boundaries.stage_12b_requirement: Prove placement decisions cannot grant financial execution authority.

boundaries.authoritative_side: Installed source, governed registry, and observed runtime evidence.
boundaries.denied_class: Override of installed source, observed runtime state, policy, registry admission, or execution authority.
boundaries.fail_closed_result: Reject or quarantine conflicting or unverifiable knowledge.
boundaries.permitted_class: Sanitized knowledge, discovery evidence, compatibility assessments, and recommendations.
boundaries.stage_12b_requirement: Prove knowledge and catalog content remain non-authoritative.

boundaries.authoritative_side: Explicit live certification and human promotion policy.
boundaries.denied_class: Live order placement, real capital movement, or implicit promotion.
boundaries.fail_closed_result: Remain paper-only and reject any live execution request.
boundaries.permitted_class: Deterministic paper orders, simulated fills, positions, cash, and evidence.
boundaries.stage_12b_requirement: Prove paper execution cannot cross into live execution without separate certification.

boundaries.denied_class: Independent task execution, policy mutation, capital authority, or promotion.
boundaries.fail_closed_result: Reject or quarantine the assignment without executing it.
boundaries.permitted_class: Assignments, issues, comments, organizational metadata, and approval references.
boundaries.stage_12b_requirement: Prove organizational assignment never becomes execution authority.

boundaries.authoritative_side: Existing governed admission and runtime policy.
boundaries.denied_class: Installation, activation, dispatch, execution, approval, capital, or policy authority.
boundaries.fail_closed_result: Reject the requested operation and preserve disabled state.
boundaries.permitted_class: Descriptive metadata, lifecycle state, capabilities, and immutable identity references.
boundaries.stage_12b_requirement: Prove registry membership cannot independently grant execution authority.

boundaries.authoritative_side: Sigil governed execution and promotion controls.
boundaries.denied_class: Live broker submission, capital movement, or portfolio mutation.
boundaries.fail_closed_result: Preserve proposal or paper state and reject live submission.
boundaries.permitted_class: Research evidence, recommendations, proposals, approvals, and paper intent.
boundaries.stage_12b_requirement: Prove research and proposal state cannot reach broker submission.

boundaries.denied_class: Self-promotion, governance mutation, financial-boundary mutation, or bypass of independent review.
boundaries.fail_closed_result: Reject or quarantine the proposal and preserve current policy.
boundaries.permitted_class: Improvement opportunities, proposals, experiment plans, results, reviews, and promotion assessments.
boundaries.stage_12b_requirement: Prove candidate generation cannot promote or alter governance.

boundaries.denied_class: Direct backend mutation, credential access, execution, installation, activation, or financial authority.
boundaries.fail_closed_result: Suppress the projection and preserve disconnected read-only state.
boundaries.permitted_class: Sanitized read-only status, sessions, tasks, approvals, and evidence projections.
boundaries.stage_12b_requirement: Prove UI visibility cannot mutate authoritative backend state.

boundaries.authoritative_side: Governed dispatcher and runtime admission policy.
boundaries.denied_class: Automatic dispatch, direct provider invocation, duplicate execution, or authority escalation.
boundaries.fail_closed_result: Reject or cancel the job without dispatching it.
boundaries.permitted_class: Validated job intent, limits, evidence requirements, and independent admission decisions.
boundaries.stage_12b_requirement: Prove accepted contracts remain non-dispatching until separately authorized.

evidence_requirements: Cumulative Stage 1 through Stage 11 validation results.
failure_conditions: The manifest is incomplete, contradictory, nondeterministic, or tampered.
A required repository reference is missing.
Any authority or financial boundary is expanded.
certification_blocks.objective: Define and validate the authoritative deterministic certification manifest.
pass_conditions: Every required component, boundary, invariant, and block is present.
Paper-only, broker-disabled, and feature-freeze invariants hold.
required_inputs: Existing Stage 1 through Stage 10 certification evidence.

failure_conditions: Evidence is missing, contradictory, or unverifiable.
certification_blocks.objective: Certify every governed producer-consumer boundary with an explicit matrix.
pass_conditions: Every permitted flow is bounded and deterministic.
No boundary grants independent execution or financial authority.
required_inputs: Stage 1 through Stage 11 source, tests, and evidence.
required_outputs: Positive and negative boundary test evidence.

evidence_requirements: Crash, interruption, corruption, and duplicate-request tests.
failure_conditions: Duplicate execution or evidence is created.
certification_blocks.objective: Certify deterministic replay, interruption recovery, idempotency, and duplicate prevention.
pass_conditions: Equivalent inputs reproduce equivalent canonical outcomes.
Interrupted state recovers to the last valid authority state.
Replay and recovery create no duplicate execution or escalation.
required_inputs: Persisted deterministic fixtures and recovery scenarios.

failure_conditions: Any prior Stage 12 block is incomplete.
certification_blocks.objective: Close the governed ecosystem and determine Golden Master readiness.
pass_conditions: All supported tests, lint, builds, packaging, and audits pass.
The repository and generated artifacts are reproducible and clean.
required_inputs: Certified Stage 12C replay and recovery evidence.
Complete build, package, audit, and repository evidence.

components.fail_closed_behavior: Reject private, authenticated, mutating, malformed, or unverifiable internet access requests.
components.rollback_or_quarantine_behavior: Disable the capability and discard untrusted research evidence.

components.fail_closed_behavior: Reject malformed, unsigned, duplicate, or unauthorized events and deny command authority.
components.rollback_or_quarantine_behavior: Disconnect or quarantine the relay without mutating runtime state.

components.fail_closed_behavior: Reject stale, incompatible, uncertified, or unauthorized node evidence and deny placement or execution.
components.rollback_or_quarantine_behavior: Quarantine the node and remove it from eligible placement.

components.fail_closed_behavior: Reject incomplete, conflicting, risky, or unverifiable catalog evidence and deny registry admission or activation.
components.rollback_or_quarantine_behavior: Hold, reject, or quarantine the candidate without installation.

components.fail_closed_behavior: Exclude disabled, stale, unhealthy, incompatible, uncertified, over-budget, or capacity-blocked nodes and deny dispatch.
components.rollback_or_quarantine_behavior: Exclude or quarantine the node and preserve non-dispatching state.

components.fail_closed_behavior: Reject malformed or unauthorized operator projections and preserve non-mutating disconnected state.
components.rollback_or_quarantine_behavior: Disable the adapter projection and preserve backend authority.

components.fail_closed_behavior: Reject malformed, stale, conflicting, or unverifiable knowledge and prevent it from becoming authoritative runtime truth.
components.rollback_or_quarantine_behavior: Quarantine the affected knowledge record or projection.

components.fail_closed_behavior: Reject malformed, conflicting, corrupt, or unauthorized registry state and preserve disabled integration status.
components.rollback_or_quarantine_behavior: Disable or quarantine the affected registry entry.

components.fail_closed_behavior: Reject invalid organizational assignments, approvals, or evidence and deny execution authority.
components.rollback_or_quarantine_behavior: Cancel or quarantine the assignment while preserving Hermes authority.

components.fail_closed_behavior: Reject incomplete evidence, missing independent review, failed regression proof, or unauthorized promotion.
components.rollback_or_quarantine_behavior: Reject or quarantine the proposal and preserve current policy.

components.fail_closed_behavior: Reject malformed, contradictory, unauthorized, or corrupt bridge state and restore the disconnected paper-only projection.
components.rollback_or_quarantine_behavior: Discard invalid projection state and rebuild the safe default snapshot.

components.fail_closed_behavior: Reject invalid contracts, evidence, admission decisions, state transitions, duplicate authority, or corrupt storage.
components.rollback_or_quarantine_behavior: Cancel or quarantine the affected job without granting dispatch.

creation_policy: The manifest contains no runtime-generated timestamp; canonical identity excludes host, process, locale, timezone, and insertion order.

invariants.statement: Broker submission remains disabled throughout Stage 12.

invariants.failure_result: Reject the artifact and fail deterministic certification.
invariants.statement: Canonical identities remain deterministic across ordering, hosts, processes, locales, and timezones.

invariants.failure_result: Restore disabled state and fail certification.
invariants.statement: Disabled integrations remain inactive unless separately governed and certified.

invariants.failure_result: Reject or reconcile the duplicate without escalation.
invariants.statement: Duplicate requests cannot create duplicate authority, dispatch, execution, evidence, or financial effects.
Golden Master readiness cannot be claimed before Stages 12B, 12C, and 12D all pass.

invariants.failure_result: Reject the operation and fail the affected gate.
invariants.statement: Malformed, stale, missing, contradictory, corrupt, or unverifiable evidence fails closed.

invariants.failure_result: Reject or quarantine the conflicting knowledge.
invariants.statement: Wiki and catalog content cannot override installed source, governed registry state, or observed runtime evidence.

invariants.failure_result: Reject the integration state and fail certification.
invariants.statement: No external integration receives independent execution, approval, capital, portfolio, or policy authority.

invariants.failure_result: Restore the last valid state and fail recovery certification.
invariants.statement: Cancellation, interruption, replay, and recovery cannot escalate authority or create duplicate execution.

invariants.failure_result: Reject and sanitize the artifact; fail certification.
invariants.statement: Secrets, credential material, private endpoints, and private host paths never appear in certification evidence or projections.
Self-evolution cannot modify governance, financial boundaries, promotion policy, or execution authority.

invariants.failure_result: Discard the projection and preserve backend authority.
invariants.statement: Desktop and operator-interface projections remain non-authoritative.

invariants.failure_result: Reject the input and preserve authoritative state.
invariants.statement: Untrusted input cannot mutate authoritative runtime, governance, financial, or policy state.

source_baseline: Stage 1 through Stage 11 implementation ending at commit 8e3694b87; source identity must be independently verified by the operator and is not derived at import time.
